label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Malan Potgieter’s Bogey Record
items.text: Louisiana senior Malan Potgieter extended his bogey-free streak to 91 consecutive holes at the NCAA Championship, breaking the NCAA record and nearing Tiger Woods’ pro record of 110.

items.headline: Soo Bin Joo Leads ShopRite LPGA
items.text: Soo Bin Joo shot a 3-under 68 in winds at Seaview and stretched her ShopRite LPGA lead to four strokes at 8-under 134 after two rounds.

items.headline: DeChambeau, Rahm Gain Tour Leverage
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm gained leverage amid a weak PGA field without stars like Scheffler and McIlroy while playing LIV Golf in Korea.
